How about if you play amaranth in combat and are then burned by the blood
hunt. I searched the archives and one post from you said the referendum was
held during the combat and another that you couldn't play reform body in
response to a blood hunt. Does this answer still hold (you can't play reform
even though it's still combat)?

Peter

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Peter Laan wrote:
> "LSJ" <vte...@white-wolf.com> wrote in message

> How about if you play amaranth in combat and are then burned by the blood
> hunt. I searched the archives and one post from you said the referendum was
> held during the combat and another that you couldn't play reform body in
> response to a blood hunt. Does this answer still hold (you can't play reform
> even though it's still combat)?

Yes, it does.
The blood hunt is conducted independently of the surrounding action and (if any)
combat. No action modifiers, reaction cards, or combat cards can be played.
